writing.sample:
Products often become unusable because a small part fails, even when most of the device still works. I largely agree that manufacturers should provide spare parts and repair instructions to independent repairers, although reasonable safeguards are needed for work that presents serious risks.

The main benefit is that this requirement would give owners a practical alternative to replacement. An independent workshop may have the skills to diagnose a fault but be unable to obtain the component needed to fix it. If the only available option is a large and expensive assembly, repairing the product may make little financial sense. Access to appropriately priced parts and accurate instructions could remove this obstacle, allowing functioning materials to remain in use. It could also support local businesses that provide repair services.

There is a further argument about choice. Purchasing a product should not leave an owner dependent on one authorised provider for every future problem. Independent repairers can offer different locations, prices and waiting times. This matters particularly where the manufacturer's own service network is difficult to reach. More options would not guarantee a successful repair in every case, but they would make it easier for owners to compare realistic alternatives.

Safety concerns nevertheless deserve attention. Some electrical components require specialist training, and inaccurate instructions could expose repairers or users to harm. Manufacturers should therefore be allowed to specify necessary qualifications for high-risk tasks, while regulators ensure that such conditions are proportionate. Safety should guide how access is provided rather than serve as a blanket reason to withhold all information.

Overall, I support a requirement to make repair possible through the independent sector. The policy should combine access to parts and reliable documentation with appropriate standards, so that consumer choice and safe practice reinforce each other.

speaking.title: 学习与技能
p1: What are you studying at the moment?
Which part of your studies do you find most interesting?
Do you prefer studying alone or with others?
speaking.p2: Describe a skill you learned that you found useful.
p2points: and explain why it is useful
p3: How have the skills needed for work changed?
Who should pay for adults to learn new skills?
Can every useful skill be assessed by an examination?
ideas: 选真实的小技能，不必编传奇经历。
按场景→困难→练习→用途组织 2 分钟。
speaking.source: 本站原创话题练习；非真实考试预测或官方题库。

speaking.title: 居住与城市
p1: What do you like about the area where you live?
Is it a convenient place for students?
Has the area changed recently?
speaking.p2: Describe a public place you enjoy spending time in.
p2points: and explain why you enjoy it
p3: What makes a public space accessible?
Should cities prioritise cars or pedestrians?
How can residents influence changes in their neighbourhood?
ideas: 描述一处可具体回忆的空间，用一次经历支撑感受。
P3 从个人偏好转向不同群体的需要。
speaking.source: 本站原创话题练习；非真实考试预测或官方题库。

speaking.title: 技术与沟通
p1: Which device do you use most often?
Do you like learning to use new technology?
When do you prefer talking in person?
speaking.p2: Describe a time technology helped you solve a problem.
p2points: and explain how helpful it was
p3: Does technology always save time?
How can people judge information online?
Should schools restrict students’ use of devices?
ideas: 不只列功能，讲问题与具体步骤。
讨论收益时补上使用条件。
speaking.source: 本站原创话题练习；非真实考试预测或官方题库。

speaking.title: 环境与自然
p1: Do you enjoy spending time outdoors?
Are there many trees near your home?
What do you do with things you no longer use?
speaking.p2: Describe a natural place you would like to visit again.
p2points: and explain why you would return
p3: Why do some people have little contact with nature?
Who is responsible for protecting local green spaces?
Can tourism help protect the environment?
ideas: 用感官细节，不要背环保议论文。
旅游收益与承载能力都可讨论。
speaking.source: 本站原创话题练习；非真实考试预测或官方题库。

speaking.title: 健康与习惯
p1: What do you do to relax?
Do you have a regular daily routine?
Is there a habit you would like to change?
speaking.p2: Describe a change you made to your daily routine.
p2points: and explain how you feel about it now
p3: Why is it difficult to maintain new habits?
How can workplaces support employee well-being?
Should public spaces encourage physical activity?
ideas: 不需要声称医学效果，讲观察到的个人变化。
P3 分析时间、环境和支持。
speaking.source: 本站原创话题练习；非真实考试预测或官方题库。

speaking.title: 工作与合作
p1: Do you enjoy working with other people?
What makes a good teammate?
How do you organise a busy day?
speaking.p2: Describe a time you worked with others to achieve something.
p2points: what you were trying to do
p3: Why do some teams work better than others?
How should a leader deal with disagreement?
Is competition always useful at work?
ideas: 用行动说明贡献，避免只说 I helped。
解释一次分歧如何解决。
speaking.source: 本站原创话题练习；非真实考试预测或官方题库。

speaking.title: 文化与阅读
p1: What do you like reading?
Did you visit museums as a child?
Do you prefer reading on paper or on a screen?
speaking.p2: Describe a book or article that made you think.
p2points: and explain why it made you think
p3: What is the role of libraries today?
Should museums be free to visit?
How do people decide which information to trust?
ideas: 可以选短文章，准确讲一个观点。
P3 比较知识获取与公共服务。
phrases: see something from a different angle
speaking.source: 本站原创话题练习；非真实考试预测或官方题库。

speaking.title: 交通与旅行
p1: How do you usually get around?
What do you do during a journey?
Do you like planning trips in detail?
speaking.p2: Describe a journey that did not go as planned.
p3: Why do people continue to use private cars?
What makes public transport reliable?
How can tourism affect residents?
ideas: 事件链清楚：计划→变化→应对→感想。
无需虚构危险事件。
speaking.source: 本站原创话题练习；非真实考试预测或官方题库。

speaking.title: 消费与维修
p1: Do you compare products before buying them?
Have you ever repaired something?
Do you prefer buying things online?
speaking.p2: Describe an object you have kept for a long time.
p2points: and explain why you have kept it
p3: Why do people replace products that still work?
Should manufacturers provide repair information?
How does advertising influence purchasing decisions?
ideas: 物品故事比价格清单更易展开。
讨论制度、信息和习惯。
phrases: get more use out of it
speaking.source: 本站原创话题练习；非真实考试预测或官方题库。

speaking.title: 时间与社区
p1: How do you usually spend weekends?
Do you know many people in your neighbourhood?
Have you helped at a local event?
speaking.p2: Describe a time you helped someone.
p2points: and explain how you felt afterwards
p3: What encourages people to volunteer?
Can small local projects make a difference?
Should students be required to do community work?
ideas: 普通真实帮助就足够，解释对方需要与具体行动。
P3 区分自愿参与与强制安排。
speaking.source: 本站原创话题练习；非真实考试预测或官方题库。

speaking.title: 决策与建议
p1: Do you usually make decisions quickly?
Who do you ask for advice?
Has your approach to decisions changed?
speaking.p2: Describe a useful piece of advice you received.
p2points: and explain why it was useful
p3: Why do people sometimes ignore good advice?
Should experts explain uncertainty when giving advice?
How can people compare conflicting recommendations?
ideas: 按建议前后变化展开，区分别人建议与自己的选择。
P3 分析信任、利益和证据。

speaking.title: 耐心与坚持
p1: Do you enjoy activities that take time to learn?

Do you prefer short or long projects?

Is giving up always a bad decision?
How should schools respond to mistakes?
ideas: 重点讲尝试之间如何调整，不只是 repeated practice。
